name: OMNI Operating Surface
purpose: Provide an operating, routing, runtime and provider-integration surface that executes against canonical OMNII and ABBA contracts.
authority_model: Routes within declared authority; it does not issue constitutional authority or replace ABBA.
data_model: Canonical runtime events and states with provenance; provider identifiers remain non-canonical.
evidence_model: Retains execution, retry, failure, cancellation and provider evidence without silent deletion.
economic_model: Operating surface only; economic meaning is delegated to canonical Value/I/O and economic compositions.
pulse_model: Routes observable outcomes and feedback to canonical Pulse pathways.
continuity_model: Provider replacement, retries and degraded execution remain attributable and recoverable.
exit_handoff: Preserve canonical entity, state, event, evidence and obligation references for receiving capability/product.
